newsitem.title: USA: CSCE October sugar at two week high on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CSCE October sugar at two week high on fund buying.

text.p: CSCE world October sugar climbed to two-week highs amid technically-driven fund buying, trading sources said.
At 1230 EDT, the benchmark contract stood 0.28 cent firmer at 11.25 cents per lb, its highest level since hitting 11.40 cents on July 1.
March rose 0.24 cent to 11.40 cents after reaching a life-of-contract high of 11.41 cents. The rest of the board was trading 0.18 to 0.03 cent firmer.

Floor sources said the October contract ran into stops around 11.12 cents which attracted more aggressive fund buying that carried the contract to the day's high, before trade scale-up selling limited gains.
Resistance in October was pegged at the recent high of 11.40 cents followed by 11.50 cents.
